mean_en: used instead of someone in negative sentences and in questions after if/whether, and after verbs such as prevent, forbid, avoid, etc.; any person at all; it does not matter who; (in negative sentences) an important person
sentence: It's very discouraging for anyone to be out of a job.
sentence_trans: 对于任何人来说，失业都是非常令人沮丧的。
word_etyma: any任何 + one一个 → anyone任何一个
